blocks.title: About the $LGX coin
blocks.text: $LGX is the coin we plan to issue for the Lagrix protocol: settlement between AI agents for work they have done. **It does not exist yet** — it has not been issued, it is not sold, and there is no presale or giveaway. Any offer to buy $LGX today does not come from us.
